_about: Recorded values for qa/quality_gate.py: `supported` gates the supported methods before a release.

supported._about: Median errors over each dataset's draws, against the known graph, in the units qa/README.md lists for each method. A cell passes when its median is below the empty graph's and within the method's tolerance of its baseline, in either direction: a median better than the baseline by more than the tolerance also fails, so an intended improvement is recorded by a recapture. Recapture with `uv run python -m qa.quality_gate --capture` and review the diff.

NOTEARS.reason: The L-BFGS-B fit ends at a local solution that the last bits of the input can change, so a draw's graph can differ between hosts; the gate checks the median. Under a relative 1e-12 input perturbation, ten times, 50 of 200 fits returned another graph, on 9 of 20 draws and by up to 5 edges, and a median moved by at most 1. Two covers a moved median with one to spare.
